profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Cisco
profile.summary: Experienced System Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in HTML, Javascript, CSS and use of file sharing services (GIT). Strong information technology professional with a Bachelor of Science (BS) focused in Computer Engineering from San Jose State University.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: MongoDB · Angular · YAML · Node.js · Snowflake

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.description:
Continued contract work

Project 1
Migrated existing Tableau pages to D3 and Angular JS. Working close with database engineers and offshore web service to create a more stable and fast single page application. The project consisted of multiple charts to be created to be implemented into an existing site. Validation and QA testing followed after development.

Project 2
Developing the next generation pricing platform for Walmart to execute prices. Allowing user to create price change scenarios, market cluster, rule sets and many more features allowing the user to have all tools necessary to perform his job with minimal effort. 

Project 3
Developing a single page application for user to make inquiries on items that would fetch retail and cost data. The application will allow users to export this data to an excel spreadsheet that will be either downloaded or email to the user. This application was design with Angular 4 and HTML 5

company.name: Ultimo Software Solutions Inc., San Jose CA

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Contracted out to Walmart in Bentonville, AR as a UI Developer.

Migrated existing Tableau pages to D3 and Angular JS. Working close with database engineers and offshore web service to create a more stable and fast single page application. The project consisted of multiple charts to be created to be implemented into an existing site. Validation and QA testing followed after development.

positions.title: System Analyst Intern
positions.description: UI Developer for an application that would help resource managers manage employee's profiles. It was built using various tools such AngularJS, CSS3, Bootstrap, D3 and HTML5

positions.title: Desktop Support
positions.description:
•	Trained to go out in the field to maintain and monitor laptops, ID printers, and cameras.
•	Collected student information and uploaded new data for the following day 
•	Installed new software and tested for new photographers to use in the field
•	Provided attentive, patient, dedicated, and innovative support to clients
•	Troubleshoot network connectivity and support Windows Operating Systems issues.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Improved Java Script coding for load testing and use Selenium for automated testing. 
•	Collaborated with 3 engineers to test and write tickets to debug their software. 
•	Created an automated code in Terminal to extract data from servers on a weekly basis. 
•	Participated in weekly discussion for ideas to encourage user to participate in the software.
